_README: PRUNE CANDIDATES ONLY. `dead` and `recipes` are the actionable lists: nothing in the flow,
no notebook and no webapp route reads them. Everything else in this file exists to stop a
future session from re-deriving a prune list by reference counting.
WHY THIS FILE WAS REWRITTEN. Until 2026-09-03 `dead` carried 26 datasets and `recipes` 25,
produced before the Target Prioritizer webapp existed. Thirteen of those datasets had since
been deleted, and of the thirteen still live, ELEVEN are read by the deployed webapp or by a
notebook. Executing the old list would have broken Acts 1, 2 and 3. Reference counting alone
flags the whole serving layer; zone membership plus a code scan is what separates it.
This file is hand-maintained. No tool generates or reads it. Re-verify before acting on it.
verified_against: live DEMO_TARGET_IDENTIFICATION: 92 datasets, 90 recipes, 14 zones; recipe I/O graph via `dku recipe get`; code scan over webapp/backend/**/*.py and notebooks/*.py

dead_detail._note: Empty. The flow has no prune candidates: the only unreferenced dataset left is `llm_hx`, which is a deliberate KEEP (see keep_do_not_prune). Any future entry here needs the same two-part evidence: no recipe input AND no hit in a code scan over webapp/backend and notebooks.

keep_do_not_prune.llm_hx: HELD FOR PART 1. Consumed by the DEMO_KG_LS visual-graph (KG Explorer) webapp backend, which no scan of this project can see. Unreferenced here is expected, not evidence. Corroborated by archive/DASHBOARD_BUILD_LOG.md:2285.
keep_do_not_prune.shap_drivers_long: compute_shap_driver_frequency -- live intermediate, not a leaf
keep_do_not_prune.validation_auc_ci: compute_family_panel -- live intermediate, not a leaf

already_deleted._note: Removed from live DSS. Retained so a future session does not re-flag them as findings. The top50_* and pairwise_* branches were superseded by the family_panel_* datasets in zone A3. `dashboard_persona_trust` and `join_trust_for_personas` were deleted 2026-09-03 with user approval as the release flow-freeze; both inputs of that join (persona_candidates, disease_pool_sizes) survived with other consumers, and zone A4 dropped from 3 datasets to 2.

shared_recipe_caution._note: A dataset may go while its producing recipe must not, because the recipe has a second output that something reads.
shared_recipe_caution.pool_unreachable_targets: unread, but `compute_pool_reachability` also produces `pool_reachability`, which nb2 reads. The dataset may go; the RECIPE MUST NOT.
